public_messages.text: I’ll inspect the apparatus description, calibration data, and current prediction interface, then implement and validate the model against the documented behavior.

The existing thermodynamic expression is only correct at half filling. For a closed sample, the chemical potential changes with temperature, so the heat capacity needs the fixed-particle-number correction (a weighted variance, not just a weighted second moment). I’m updating that and fitting the common width by weighted least squares over the allowed interval.

The implementation now passes the public calibration test. I also checked the off-half-filling result against a numerical derivative of the fixed-filling internal energy; the corrected expression agrees to about 1e-11 in the tested cases.

- Implemented weighted least-squares calibration for `Model.fit`.
